capabilities_done: wire: Envelope{bridge_version,correlation_id,idempotency_key,actor,resource_id,expected_revision,lease_epoch,body} with bodies grant_check|commit|lookup|job_admit|job_release|diagnostic and Reply{bridge_version,correlation_id,result}; canonical compact JSON; decode refuses unknown/duplicate fields, foreign bridge_version (read first, alone), leading/trailing bytes, oversize, invalid DomainId, invalid actor/key, non-lowercase hex, and (R5) anything that does not re-encode to the input bytes (non_canonical); stable distinct codes (12 asserted in wire_strictness_and_descriptor, non_canonical in only_canonical_bytes_decode)

host: HostBridge + TransientHost (memory only): grants per principal/resource/action with revoke, commit rechecks grant even for a known key, idempotency bound to principal+resource+binding, lease-epoch fence, expected-revision compare, successor == expected+1 (checked), monotonic receipts, FaultPlan, independent inspection API; R5: job tickets bound to account+principal+resource (admission needs a standing grant, release by another owner is job denied not_ticket_owner), lease epoch host-owned (older = stale_epoch, newer = rejected epoch_not_issued, never adopted)

adapter: BridgePorts<H>.grants()/commits()/jobs() over session GrantPort/CommitPort/JobPort; no/undecodable/mismatched reply => denied grant, refused job, commit Unknown; lookup() for reconcile; one best-effort diagnostic per terminal commit result

notes.design: session owns the port traits and private doubles; this crate owns the public wire envelopes and the executable transient adapter

no async/threads/transport by design; HostBridge is synchronous bytes in/out

host.rs commit: lease_epoch < host epoch = StaleEpoch, > host epoch = Rejected{epoch_not_issued}, and a commit no longer stores the caller's epoch
